purpose: Registry of external public plant-disease datasets that may improve generic visual feature learning without being mislabeled as Cannabis ground truth.

rules.cannabisGroundTruth: Only Cannabis/hemp samples with Cannabis-specific provenance and diagnosis evidence may enter Cannabis diagnosis evaluation sets.
rules.crossCropTraining: Cross-crop samples may be used for representation learning, generic symptom localization, negative examples, and robustness testing when license terms permit.
rules.labelTransfer: Never copy a non-Cannabis crop disease label directly into a Cannabis diagnosis class solely because the visual symptom looks similar.
rules.evaluationIsolation: External transfer datasets must not be mixed into the Cannabis test set or used to inflate Cannabis diagnostic accuracy claims.

datasets.name: PlantVillage
prohibitedUse: direct disease-class transfer without Cannabis evidence

datasets.name: Clean Plant Disease Detection Dataset v1
qualityNotes: dataset card reports zero invalid YOLO labels
dataset card reports zero near-duplicate images across train/validation/test under its audit threshold
